title: Every monomorphism of schemes is separated
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Assume $f$ is a monomorphism: for every scheme $T$ and morphisms $a,b:T\to X$, the equality $f\circ a=f\circ b$ implies $a=b$. Then $f$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], meaning that its diagonal $\Delta_f:X\to X\times_YX$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is a closed immersion. No finite-type or quasi-compactness hypothesis is imposed.
